thread:
maria_support: Customer on seat-retention reported that on iPhone portrait the chart legend labels are cutoff and tooltips map to the wrong series. Sent screenshots: https://redwood.screenshots/ri-12345.png

ava_mobile: thanks — can repro on iPhone 14 / Safari in Simulator. Legend items wrap into a single line and labels overlap. Tooltips hover on wrong color swatch when tapping the legend.

maria_support: customer says dashboard shows 2 series in legend but chart only plots 1 series sometimes, and tooltip shows the hidden series name. They noticed it after today's frontend deploy around 08:10 UTC.

tanvi_product: tagging @sam_dev and @will_sre — could this be the responsive legend work (responsive-legend-v2) that went live today?

deploy_bot: deploy finished: frontend@prod 2026-02-18T08:09:45Z by sam_dev (sha: a1b2c3d)

sam_dev: yes that flag was rolled to 100% at 08:10. I pushed CSS/JS to switch to flex-based legend layout to handle long labels.

ava_mobile: quick repro steps: 1) iPhone 14 portrait 2) open /console/dashboards/retention 3) rotate to portrait 4) tap legend item — note tooltip appears for different series 5) inspect with Safari remote — legend container computed width smaller than expected, items overlap.

will_sre: can you paste the computed styles? suspect overflow/clip or z-index.

ava_mobile: computed CSS snippet:

.legend { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: nowrap; align-items: center; }
.legend-item { max-width: 80px; white-space: normal; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

when I change flex-wrap to wrap and set .legend-item { white-space: nowrap } the labels break to multiple lines but no overlap. Tooltip hit target seems off because we changed pointer-events layering in the legend marker element.

sam_dev: aha — I changed marker span to position: absolute; to align with truncated labels. That will shift pointer targets. Immediate mitigation: revert marker positioning and keep flex layout, or flip the feature flag.

tanvi_product: impact: 2 customers reported, mobile-safari mostly, some Android Chrome. Severity P2 — UX broken and may hide series.

maria_support: escalated to customer success; provided workaround: use desktop or rotate phone to landscape.

will_sre: logs show no backend errors — purely client UI. No analytics missing; only rendering mismatch.

sam_dev: patch ready: revert marker positioning + add test to check legend tap target coordinates. CSS patch:

.legend { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.legend-marker { position: static; margin-right:6px; }

I'll release a hotfix to canary now and flip responsive-legend-v2 back for mobile 08:50 UTC.

deploy_bot: canary deploy started: frontend@canary (sha: a1b2c3d-hotfix)

ava_mobile: canary verified on iPhone 12/14 simulators — legend behaves, tooltips align.

sam_dev: rolling to prod and flag rollback at 08:58 UTC.

deploy_bot: prod deploy: frontend@prod (sha: a1b2c3d-hotfix) completed 08:59 UTC

maria_support: sent update to customer — closing escalation if no further reports.

tanvi_product: follow-up: add automated visual regression for legend on small widths and include pointer-events tests in Cypress.

sam_dev: created GH issue #4127 with repro bundle and test plan.

maria_support: thanks team :thumbsup:
